title: The List That Changed Nowhere: What JavaScript Does to a List Property, and the Model That Says So
fallback: This lesson is about lists crossing into QML, so it needs Qt. Lesson 09-05 is about copies of a Qt container that are shared until one is written, and lesson 03-09 about a view into a vector that goes stale. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.
